answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can submit votes, with one vote per bond and a fixed review window. When independent, randomly selected peers confirm a participant is a duplicate, slash its bond and distribute part to reviewers; otherwise return it. A sybil attacker must lock up capital for every identity and risks losing it, so scaling fake accounts becomes costly rather than free. Keep bond size modest so genuine newcomers from a tundra, an inlet, or a mesa can still participate.
